findings.statement: The proposed contextual digital-substitution predictor fails to improve reserved-region branch-use risk over the frozen controls.
findings.applicability: Complete-case banked adult survey with positive WEIGHT_FINAL; WEIGHT_ALT is not used. Region-balanced survey-weighted risk is not national prevalence. DK/refused/skipped are exclusions, not non-use. Geographic author-derived indicators are not measured travel distance.
findings.limitations: The positive transfer claim is unsupported: reference Brier exceeds prevalence, channel-count and flexible controls in region1.
findings.falsification: The positive transfer claim is unsupported: reference Brier exceeds prevalence, channel-count and flexible controls in region1.
